## Context
The demand model is ready, but the Kingsport FC board must approve any price that moves more than 15% from face value ([[Declan Moorcroft]]).

## Decision
Pause [[Dynamic pricing pilot]]. No price changes this season before board sign-off.

## Consequences
Board paper due 20 October.
